source_title: Justin Boots Announces Partnership with ACM Entertainer of The Year Cody Johnson to Introduce a Collection Made for Every Occasion
source_excerpt:
FORT WORTH, Texas , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Justin Boots welcomes ACM Entertainer of the Year and Western lifestyle advocate Cody Johnson to Team Justin with the introduction of a new collection of boots carefully curated by Cody and the Justin Boots team.
Built on a shared passion for Western tradition, quality craftsmanship and authentic Western style, the collection combines Cody's personal vision with Justin Boots' legacy in creating footwear made for the way people live today. Each style was thoughtfully curated by Cody and the Justin Boots team, resulting in a versatile assortment with something for everyone, from everyday wear to special occasions.
The collection offers a boot for every special moment. The initial launch features a variety of silhouettes, leathers and stitch patterns, giving wearers the opportunity to find a style that fits their personality and needs while staying true to the tradition of Justin Boots.
"From the start, Cody wanted to make sure we were creating an all-encompassing collection," said Shelbi Tidwell, director of product development for Justin Brands. "He has a genuine appreciation for Western culture and understands what people are looking for in a quality pair of boots. Working alongside him allowed us to create a collection that feels truly authentic to Cody while offering something for everyone."
For Cody, the partnership is a natural fit, reflecting his deep connection to the Western lifestyle and appreciation for a well-made pair of boots.
The collection reflects the shared values of Cody Johnson and Justin Boots: authenticity and quality. With styles designed for a variety of occasions, the collection invites everyone to find their pair and make it their own.
The Cody Johnson by Justin collection is available at participating retailers and at JustinBoots.com .
Justin is a brand of Western footwear, apparel, and accessories that was founded in 1879 by H.J. Justin. The company is headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas, and produces a variety of boots for both men and women, including cowboy boots , cowgirl boots , work boots , and casual shoes. Justin also offers a wide range of men's, women's and kids' apparel and accessories, including cowboy hats , jeans , belts , handbags , and more. Justin is known for its high-quality craftsmanship and use of premium materials and has a reputation for being a trusted brand in the western market. For more information, visit justinboots.com .

Cody Johnson , who "just might be the future of real country music," continues to live up to those expectations as his reputation and popularity grow among fans, the media, and the music industry. Since the release of his highly praised sixth album, Banks Of The Trinity , this summer, his accolades have continued to surge.
After completing his UK Tour this weekend, Cody will wrap his touring year with nearly half a million tickets sold, excluding fairs and festival dates. At the end of 2025, he landed on Billboard's Top 100 Tours list with more than 400,000 tickets sold. Nashville's Tennessean called Cody 'the evening's biggest superstar' and praised his voice, saying, 'As a crooner, Johnson may have one of the underrated best vocal styles in music overall. When he grounds his feet and sets his mind to it, he unleashes a stunning instrument that leaves his crowd in awe.'
His industry honors include being named ACM Entertainer of the Year and Male Artist of the Year at the 2026 ACM Awards, bringing his ACM total to four wins. Cody has been named CMT Artist of the Year, has won four CMA Awards (including the coveted Album of the Year Award for Leather in 2024), has won three CMT Music Awards, and has been named "Best New Country Artist" at the iHeart Music Awards. His television appearances have entertained fans on the Today Show, the Kelly Clarkson Show, and the Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon, and he has delivered standout live TV performances at the iHeart Music Awards, the ACM Awards, the CMA Awards, the CMT Music Awards, CMT Giants honoring Vince Gill, and the CMT Artist of the Year Special. Last summer, Cody co-hosted the three-hour "CMA Fest Presented by Sofi" with Ashley McBryde.
Cody has four nominations for the upcoming 60 th Annual CMA Awards: Entertainer of The Year, Male Vocalist of the Year, Single of the Year ("The Fall"), and Video of the Year for Cody's massive #1 hit "The Fall."
